notes: Representative-elect with no house.gov site; campaign site jaceyarbrough.com redirects to https://jaceforcongress.com/. The priorities page (https://jaceforcongress.com/priorities, read at source on 2026-11-14 with an exact-text download) says: "It’s vital that we win the AI race – the new space race – and promote manufacturing and infrastructure here in Texas at the federal level." and "It's imperative that we win the new space race and beat China to the punch on AI investment and development." Both are level D (competition with China). They are left out of `statements` only because the page is undated and the brief requires the date the statement was made; the campaign ran from late 2025 through the 3 November 2026 election. A reviewer may add them with a date if one can be established. Six web searches ran, none refused; none found any statement by him on AI risk, superintelligence, extinction, a pause or slowdown, or an agreement with China. He is not a sitting House member, so he could not sponsor or co-sponsor the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act, and he did not sign the House AI letters. Ballotpedia (https://ballotpedia.org/Jace_Yarbrough) returned an empty page through the fetch tool, and a Dallas Express profile returned HTTP 403, so neither could be checked for AI remarks.
